Subject: GCP Marketplace fee & promo credit structure for Redwood listing

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday. Per our conversation, I wanted to share the baseline program structure we typically offer new ISV listings on Google Cloud Marketplace and outline a few promotional credit options to support initial demand.

High level:
- Standard listing fee: 8% gross revenue share for SaaS listings (applies to transacted SaaS and metered billing).
- Early-launch rebate: up to 25% rebate on fees for the first 6 months based on usage thresholds.
- Promotional credits: we can provide $25k in free GCP credits for customers who sign during the launch quarter; credits are applied to Google Cloud invoices.

I'm attaching the standard fee schedule and a sample seller agreement for reference (see attached). Happy to set up a short follow-up to walk through the mechanics.

Are there any specific procurement/contract concerns we should be aware of on your side (data residency, indemnity caps, SOC 2 evidence)?

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Lin
Partner Programs, Google Cloud Marketplace
sophie.lin@google.com

Thanks Sophie — this is a helpful starting point. A few quick items from our side:

1) Fee structure: 8% is within expectations but we need clarity on how refunds/chargebacks are treated for gross revenue calculations.
2) Early-launch rebate: can the rebate be applied as a fee credit rather than a retroactive cash payment? That helps our accounting.
3) Credits: we appreciate the $25k — is that a program-level pool (shared across customers) or per-signup? We need to set expectations for GTM.
4) Compliance: we will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a commitment that no customer data is stored in a Google-managed service as part of the listing process unless explicitly agreed.

Looping in Monica (Procurement) and Marissa (Partnerships) to handle legal/finance and GTM planning. Can we schedule a 30-minute call next week to align on contract and promotional timing?

Thanks,
Jonas

Hi team — appreciate the quick follow. A few clarifications below and I attached the formal fee schedule and a draft seller agreement (Redwood-specific markups) for legal.

Responses:
- Refunds/chargebacks: revenue share is calculated on net collected revenue after transaction refunds; we can include clear language in the schedule.
- Rebate mechanics: yes, we can apply the early-launch rebate as a fee credit against Marketplace fees (applied monthly) rather than an external cash payment.
- Promo credits: the $25k is a per-launch pool for Redwood (not per-customer). We can discuss additional campaign credits tied to referral volume.
- Compliance: we can provide SOC 2 Type II attestation and a data handling addendum. GCP will not host customer data on your behalf as part of the listing unless you opt into managed services.

Proposed next steps:
1) Review attached seller agreement and fee schedule (GCP_fee_schedule_2027.xlsx; Redwood_Seller_Agreement_v2.pdf).
2) Procurement & Legal call — please propose 2 windows next week.
3) If terms are acceptable, I can issue a DocuSign for the seller agreement and open the promotional credit pool upon signature.

Happy to jump on a call Thursday morning or Friday afternoon PT — let me know what works.

Best,
Sophie

Sophie / Jonas,

Thanks for the details — reviewed the draft agreement. A few procurement/legal asks before we can proceed to signature:

- Indemnity and liability caps: we prefer a mutual limitation to a multiple of 12 months of fees, with carve-outs for gross negligence. Please advise if GCP can accept that.
- Data processing: add clear DPA attachment; we require data export/portability language and a 30-day notice for any changes to data handling that affect customers.
- Audit rights: we request SOC 2 evidence and a right to review any security concerns raised by customers that relate to the listing.
- Fee reconciliation: need monthly reporting schedule and an automated CSV export or API endpoint for fee reconciliation.

If GCP can accept these, we're comfortable moving quickly. Proposed times for a legal/procurement alignment call:
- Thurs 04/15 10:00–10:30 PT
- Fri 04/16 09:00–09:30 PT

Jonas / Marissa — are those windows okay on your end?
